item.title: Oil- and gas-driven project pipeline in the Middle East climbs to $55 billion in upcoming contracts
item.description: The Middle East is the cornerstone of the oil and gas sector, and has revealed that a pipeline project has reached an astonishing $55 billion in contracts.

item.title: Brazos Midstream commissions $185 million Sundance II gas-processing facility in Martin County
item.description: Brazos Midstream has commissioned a $185 million gas processing facility in the Permian Basin, close to Martin County in Texas, the United States.

item.title: Rajasthan begins allocating land for the new Petro Zone in Pachpadra, India
item.description: India is increasing energy generation capacity by allocating land for a new Petro Zone in the state of Rajasthan, the backbone of the nation's energy market.

item.title: Everfuel brings its 20 MW HySynergy green hydrogen facility online in Fredericia, Denmark
item.description: Everfuel has brought a 20 MW HySynergy green hydrogen facility online in Denmark, marking a new era of hydrogen production and exporting in the energy market.

item.title: North Sea sees zero bids for new wind farm construction permits
item.description: The Dutch government got zero bids for new North Sea wind farm permits in its latest tender process, which the Netherlands said came as no surprise.

item.title: ADB funds Central Asia’s biggest solar complex in Uzbekistan, pairing 1 GW PV with 1,336 MWh storage
item.description: The Asian Development Bank (ADB), along with several other large lenders, is set to fund what will be Central Asia's largest solar complex in Uzbekistan.

item.title: On-peak hours changed in November — Families will directly note it in December as TOU becomes harder
item.description: Exel has made a few changes to its on-peak hours rates in order to ensure the continued safe delivery of crucial electricity during all periods of the year.

item.title: Petronas kicks off procurement drive for subsea systems on two upcoming offshore developments
item.description: Petronas, Malaysia's state-owned oil company, has kicked off a procurement drive for subsea systems on two upcoming offshore energy developments.

item.title: Enbridge approves $1.4 billion project to expand Canadian crude capacity into U.S. refining markets
item.description: Enbridge, a Canadian energy major, has revealed plans to expand its crude capacity into the US refining markets, setting the stage for a $1.4 billion expansion

item.title: Dangote Group to enlarge Nigeria’s mega-refinery to 1.4 million barrels per day
item.description: The Dangote Group has announced its plans to enlarge its mega-refinery in Nigeria, Africa to reach a capacity of 1.4 million barrels of oil per day.
